title: An Almgren-type formula for planar $p$-harmonic functions
summary: For a nonconstant planar $p$-harmonic function $u$, with $1 < p < \infty$, and according to previous results, most notably Aronsson's fundamental analysis of the hodograph representation in a neighborhood of an isolated critical point, we introduce the flux-normalized frequency $$ N_*(x_0,r) = \frac{r\displaystyle\int_{B_r(x_0)} |D u|^p\,dx} {\displaystyle\int_{\partial B_r(x_0)} |D u|^{p-2}(u-u(x_0))^2\,dS}. $$ This ratio constitutes the natural counterpart of Almgren's frequency function in the nonlinear setting, as it recovers precisely the degree of homogeneity for every homogeneous…
